meta.description: Use when accelerating existing genomics workflows with NVIDIA Parabricks, improving runtime or price/performance, converting pipeline steps to GPUs, or comparing CPU and GPU workflow outputs. Adds optional GPU steps in-place with runtime toggles (default off). Do NOT use for individual pbrun command routing — use parabricks.

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive workflow acceleration coverage across 4 frameworks (Nextflow, Snakemake, WDL, Python); minor gap: no guidance for CWL or DSL2-specific patterns beyond generic Nextflow

reliability.note: Strong guardrails against destructive actions and clinical overreach; A/B comparison required before production; minor: no guidance on handling Parabricks version mismatches between environments

performance_context.note: 307-line SKILL.md with 7 reference files; progressive disclosure present but SKILL.md exceeds 250-line target for complex skills; could benefit from moving framework-specific patterns to references

agent_usability.note: Clear 9-step workflow with decision trees; excellent guardrails; minor inconsistency: reference files listed at top but some inline tables duplicate reference content

human_usability.note: Good trigger coverage; report-only mode documented; minor: toggle naming conventions (use_parabricks vs accelerated) not consolidated into single recommendation

security.note: Explicit guardrails against secret exposure and destructive cleanup; git branch recommendation before edits; minor: no validation guidance for user-provided workflow paths (path traversal risk)

maintainability.note: Good modular structure with 7 reference files; framework patterns isolated; minor: tool mapping tables in both SKILL.md and references create update burden

agent_specific.note: Excellent trigger precision with explicit negative case (NOT for individual pbrun routing); strong composability with parabricks skill; clear escape hatches in troubleshooting; minor: no idempotency statement for repeated acceleration attempts

key_strengths: Comprehensive multi-framework support (Nextflow, Snakemake, WDL, Python) with concrete implementation patterns for each
Strong safety-first design with default-off toggles, git branch recommendations, and mandatory A/B comparison before production
Excellent guardrails preventing clinical overreach, destructive operations, and fabrication of pipeline structures
Clear scope boundaries with explicit exclusion of single-command routing and delegation to parabricks skill
Detailed 9-step workflow from intake through consolidation with framework-specific guidance and troubleshooting table

recommendations.title: Enforce A/B comparison prerequisite before consolidation
recommendations.problem: Step 7 consolidation assumes comparison completed but does not validate or block if comparison not run
recommendations.root_cause: Sequential step design assumes linear workflow but agent could jump to consolidation prematurely
recommendations.fix: Add to Step 7 first paragraph: 'Before consolidating, verify A/B comparison completed (check ACCELERATION.md for comparison results). If comparison section is empty or comparison not run, prompt user to complete Step 8 first.'

recommendations.title: Move framework-specific patterns to reference files
recommendations.problem: 307-line SKILL.md exceeds target for complex skills; implementation patterns tables could move to references
recommendations.root_cause: Inline pattern tables for 4 frameworks add bulk to main instruction flow
recommendations.fix: Create references/framework-patterns.md with detailed toggle and wiring examples for each framework; keep only 1-2 line summaries in SKILL.md Step 6 table; reference full patterns document for details

recommendations.title: Add path validation guidance to security section
recommendations.problem: User-provided workflow paths not validated for traversal attacks or non-existent locations
recommendations.root_cause: Assumes paths are trustworthy; no defensive validation documented
recommendations.fix: Add to Prerequisites: 'Validate workflow path exists and is within expected project boundaries before reading. Reject paths containing .. or absolute paths outside project root unless explicitly authorized.'

recommendations.title: Consolidate toggle naming recommendation
recommendations.problem: Both use_parabricks and accelerated shown as alternatives without clear guidance on which to prefer
recommendations.root_cause: Framework table shows two naming patterns without declaring one canonical
recommendations.fix: In Step 6 Toggle contract table header, add note: 'Prefer use_parabricks for consistency across all frameworks; accelerated is acceptable alternative but maintain single convention within a project.'
